verdict.rationale: Brave's docs show all three pieces are exposed through one API surface: Web Search returns pre-extracted content optimized for RAG/agents, the LLM Context endpoint is built for machine consumption, and the summarization/AI-answers endpoints synthesize results — and the official MCP server bundles search plus 'AI-powered summarization' and 'LLM context' as tools for agents. However, community evidence shows the standard free-tier ToS explicitly prohibits using responses for AI inference, forcing agent users onto a separate AI Inference plan — a real friction point for the exact 'agent running research flow' use case, and there's no independent hands-on report of a full search→extract→synthesize chain actually executing end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the full multi-step flow, and clarity that the AI Inference plan removes the ToS restriction without added complexity.
